question: Does replacing only the student ReLU with Identity recover cross-optimizer U alignment, with the original nonlinear teacher, data and initial Linear tensors held fixed?

predictions.P1: At q=0.5, every non-reference optimizer by architecture pair has median relative endpoint error <=5% across the three paired seeds, with all three comparisons uncensored.
predictions.P2: At least one optimizer-by-architecture pair at q=0.1 or q=0.01 has median relative endpoint error >5% or fewer than 3/3 uncensored comparisons.

data.task: synthetic nonlinear scalar regression from a fixed one-hidden-layer ReLU teacher (16-32-1); student is a trainable deep affine network with Identity activations
data.target_scaling: center/scale using training target mean and standard deviation; same transform on validation
data.pairing: within architecture and seed, all optimizers share data, validation set, initial weights and initial loss

training.batching: full batch, fixed order, no shuffling
training.determinism: PyTorch deterministic algorithms; one CPU thread; fixed seeds; no stochastic layers

U_definition.purpose: empirically test the constant-initial-gradient parameter-displacement calibration without a loss-mode decomposition
U_definition.globalization: compute coordinatewise predicted displacement under constant g0, then take its Euclidean norm as scalar U
U_definition.AdamW: ||theta_const(t)-theta0||2 under decoupled shrinkage c=1-eta*wd, including shrinkage in total displacement
U_definition.comparison: per architecture/seed/q, observed SGD first-crossing defines target U; predict each other method's first t with U(t)>=target and compare to observed first-crossing

outcomes.primary: relative absolute endpoint error |t_pred-t_obs|/t_obs at q=.5; report each optimizer/architecture median over three paired seeds and uncensored denominator
outcomes.secondary: same at q=.9/.1/.01; sustained-to-T endpoints; validation thresholds; saved original loss curves against raw U; affine least-squares floor and threshold attainability diagnostics
outcomes.censoring: unreached observed threshold or predicted U crossing by T=2000 remains null; do not impute T
outcomes.tolerance: 5% inherited from D1; report continuous errors and every denominator

ablation.only_architecture_change: student hidden ReLU replaced by Identity, preserving state_dict keys and RNG consumption
ablation.paired_reference: d1_nn_u_transfer_r1/r001_nn_u_transfer; original ReLU runs will not be rerun or overwritten
ablation.important_difference: same initial Linear tensors, but initial predictions, L0 and g0 differ after activation removal; U is recomputed
ablation.residual_diagnostic: fit affine OLS on training data with an intercept; report L_affine_star/L0 for every training cell and flag q below this lower bound as class-unattainable
ablation.metrics: store all 2001 per-step loss and U values in separate metrics files, plus 401-point curves
ablation.prediction_interpretation: P1 is a falsifiable alignment hypothesis, not an expectation of success; P2 includes censoring as an evidence limit, not as a measured endpoint error
ablation.plotting: linear raw U; original L/L0 on log y; initial x focus is the largest first U reaching floor_ratio+0.01*(1-floor_ratio), over trajectories that reach it, or full x if none; full trajectories and t=2000 markers retained; no subtraction from primary loss metric

scope_limits: development only; synthetic regression is not a benchmark or real-task test
three factorized affine architectures and three paired seeds; seeds do not add architecture conditions; no claim that the joint parameter loss is quadratic
no quadratic-loss mode decomposition is assumed; scalar Euclidean aggregation of coordinate U is an operational choice, not a theorem
one common learning rate and fixed optimizer settings; no hyperparameter tuning or optimizer ranking
no claim about classification, CNNs, transformers, minibatch noise, other data distributions, or learning rates
